name: Grand world: hunters
description: The grand world without the four things that stop meat eaters from taking hold: the climate (seasons, weather, day and night, ice ages and droughts, the cost of heat and cold, torpor), sex, harmful mutations, and kin restraint with herds and sharing. Everything else stays: a 512 x 512 world with continents, three kinds of plant, nutrients carried through food, brains, disease, camouflage, aging, litters, colonies, land damage, fires, storms, floods and blights. On 16 seeds a lasting group of meat eaters formed in 13 (about 90 animals on average), with 2.7 feeding levels, 29% more species than the grand world and a bigger, steadier population, but lives half as long (devlog 19). Watch the diet chart and the red dots.
